title: Made War Of the Worlds In 7 Days | Is It Production Ready?
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
Following the [AI Game Development Prompts](https://github.com/Glitch-Gaming-Platform/AI-Prompts-For-Game-Development) I put get together, I created War Of the Worlds, but is it production ready to sell?

I'll be talking about the process the [AI Gaming Festival ](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/view/standalone)so RSVP to here talks about AI Game Development. If you are unfamiliar with the series, it was originally a book published in 1898 by H.G. Wells, then was made into a movie in 2005 with Tom Cruise, and has had a few TV series based on it.

[Play Online or PC Here](https://www.glitch.fun/games/ad467bbb-ca91-44e9-8016-5067cdce954c/play)

In this version of War of the Worlds, it's the same aliens, except you must defend your city from them and overcome the waves. You lose if they take your capital. So, it's Tower Defense meets City Builder.

True to the original story, the game takes place in the 1900s. No fighter jets, no nuclear weapons, just good ole cannons, firing squads, and telegrams.

When building your society, you have to manage how coal is distributed because all businesses, homes, and the military run off of coal.

Like other city builders, there is trade, professions, beautification, and other cool things you can build.

As you build your society, waves of Tripods and other aliens keep coming. You have to balance defending against them while growing your city.

comments.author: Inkwalker
comments.body:
The cinematic part screams AI slop. There are way to many inconsistences.

Gameplay footage looks terrible. Assets look like programmer art., there is no animations, no juice. Shaders also wrong. Why is the grass so shiny?

It's definitely not production ready.

replies.author: No-Aardvark-3840
replies.body: The entire thing screams AI slop…. And I say that as a firm supporter and user of AI

comments.author: fued
comments.body: still probably months away from being production ready at absolute best honestly. Potentially even a year

comments.author: FailedGradAdmissions
comments.body:
I'll be brutally honest, the cinematics look nothing at all like the actual game. Don't make cinatic trailers, they leave a worse taste than showing initial gameplay footage right from the start. Basically, you are raising people's expectations by showing them cinematics and the it's a bloodbath when they see the actual gameplay.

I bet people here and the general public would have been way more friendlier if you had shown the gameplay footage right from the start along. It's good progress for being build over a week, and a good POC but doesn't seem production ready.

comments.author: Am_Biyori
comments.body: The trailer relies to heavily on cinematic cut scenes, and there's a huge gap between what those scenes promise and what the gameplay actually delivers. Remember you're your games first play tester. ask yourself: when looking through everything Steam has, would I enjoy playing this?

comments.author: LL555LL
comments.body: It's been 7 Days in working and it needs a lot more passes for quality before I would buy it. Especially the animations and the shaders and also maybe creating something in the background other than just black.

comments.author: papapumpnz
comments.body: In game assets are pretty poor. It looks like a quick threejs knockup by your ai over a weekend. Im sure it wasn't over a weekend to build, but still. Are you expecting people to pay for it?
